uddhata.p: [U+hana+ta] (ti) CL=7 [Hana gatiyaṃ, uddhaṃ uddhaṃ hanati gacchatīti uddhato, to, hanassa dho asarūpadvittaṃ. Dhāna,ṭī,169] (1) One who is frightened, has a restless mind, and is not calm. (2) One who is arrogant and brags. Uddhata(ti) [u+dhara+ta] (A) It should be taken out upwards. (B) It should be pulled out. (C) It should be taken out and rescued. (D) It should be lifted.
